meta_data.base_class: Assess the <specific ecological metric> in a forest area using satellite imagery. - applicable for assessing various observable environmental or geographical attributes of an identified forest area.

tool_template.name: EcoDiversityMonitor_assess_<class>
tool_template.description: Assess the <class> in a forest area using satellite imagery.

area_identifier.description: A unique identifier for the forest area of interest.

detailed_report.description: Whether to generate a detailed report on <class>.

time_period.description: The time period for which the <class> assessment is conducted, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD', start date, end date.

imagery_resolution.description: The resolution of the satellite imagery used for assessing the <class>, e.g., high, medium, or low.

confidence_threshold.description: The confidence threshold as a percentage for the satellite imagery analysis when assessing the <class>. Must be between 0 and 100.

comparison_baseline.description: A reference baseline for comparison, such as a previous assessment or historical average, when monitoring changes in <class>.

data_source.description: The source of the satellite imagery data used for assessing the <class>, e.g., specific satellite name or agency.
